note: Research analyst, 2026-09-22, SECOND AND FINAL FORM after the integrity officer's vetting round. The full pre-registration is at analytics/daily-research/2026-09-22.md sections 1.7 and 5, and this note must be read with BOTH; where the first form and this one differ, THIS ONE GOVERNS and the differences are itemised here. WITHDRAWN FROM THE FIRST FORM, by sustained objection: (a) '23 of 23 rows refused from 2026-08-10 onward' - WRONG, see the corrected figures below (0922-B2); (b) 'across five path shapes' - NOT COMPUTED and unreachable at any unit, see below (0922-B3); (c) 'ZERO non-PDF allowlisted-host locators serving NAFTA Chapter Eleven text have been identified' and the phrase 'the ONLY identified candidate that could ever satisfy the section 6.4 condition' - BOTH WITHDRAWN; they contradict each other and the second is true while the first is false (0922-B4); (d) 'the four never-fired www/bare twins on our allowlist are probably four redundant entries rather than four untested hosts' - WITHDRAWN as a licence wider than its row (0922-B6); (e) 'a clean two-cell experiment' - WITHDRAWN, it has at least four cells (0922-B7). HEADLINE PREDICTION, UNCHANGED AND AGAINST THIS SEAT'S OWN INTEREST: THIS BATCH WILL NOT CLOSE GAP-UNRESOLVED nafta-chapter-11-allowlisted-host-visible-prose-untested. NO ROW IN IT CAN. Rows 1-4 are at a case page, which does not serve the chapter's text under the reading this seat recorded before firing. Row 5 is a PDF endpoint and excerpt_of returns the empty string for any content type that is neither html nor text (scripts/fetch_relay.py:124-125). Row 6 is an IISD toolkit page on indirect expropriation, not a page serving NAFTA Chapter Eleven. Row 7 is a PDF download endpoint, same bar. Row 8 is the closing bracket. THE REASON NO WINNING ROW IS PROPOSED IS NOW STATED CORRECTLY: not that no satisfier exists, but that every identified candidate is either tool-refused, under a standing council prohibition, or unfetched, and NONE HAS BEEN READ. NOT FETCHED IS NEVER 'NOT IDENTIFIED'. Two identified candidates - https://www.italaw.com/investment-treaties/nafta (allowlisted, non-PDF, slug naming NAFTA, refused 403 on 3 of 3 rows on 2026-09-21) and https://investmentpolicy.unctad.org/international-investment-agreements/treaties/bit/3104/nafta-1992- (allowlisted, non-PDF, refused 403 on 2 of 2 rows on 2026-09-20) - are excluded from this batch BY COUNCIL PROHIBITION, which is a fact about our spending policy and not about those resources. A further 64 allowlisted, non-PDF, https locators sit in committed analytics/search-results/ with zero rows ever fired at them; none has been screened for NAFTA content. FOUR QUESTIONS THIS BATCH DOES SETTLE. (1) Rows 1-3: does this relay obtain visible prose naming NAFTA and Chapter Eleven at an allowlisted host? pca-cpa.org is 11 of 11 ok with 9 non-empty html excerpts across exactly three prior paths, and /en/cases/50/ has never been fired. Expectation: ok/200/text/html with non-empty excerpts on all three. (2) Row 1 vs row 4: does the www/bare host spelling matter at this origin? FOUR OUTCOME CELLS, NOT TWO, and only the first licenses 'the spelling is immaterial': (i) SERVED INDEPENDENTLY - row 4 ok and final_url equals the requested url: the www spelling is independently served, and ONLY THIS CELL licenses 'immaterial at this origin', which licenses nothing about the other three pairs; (ii) SERVED VIA REDIRECT - row 4 ok and final_url DIFFERS from the requested url: polite_get calls requests.get with default redirect following and tests only the final status (src/sources/base.py), so this records the BARE host answering a fourth time in this run, NOT independent service at the www spelling; it is the origin naming one spelling canonical and the other a redirector, and it licenses the OPPOSITE inference for italaw.com, where a bare-to-www redirect would mean firing italaw.com simply arrives at www.italaw.com and inherits its 403; (iii) robots_disallowed AT ONE SPELLING ONLY - robots_allowed caches by urlparse(url).netloc with no www stripping and fails open on error (src/sources/base.py), and rows 4 and 6 each trigger a fresh robots.txt fetch at a host never fetched, so a one-sided robots_disallowed is a robots.txt artefact and NOT a serving difference; (iv) REFUSED - a tool-layer outcome that says nothing about what the origin serves to a browser. The first form of this note omitted cells (ii) and (iii) and omitted robots_disallowed from row 4's outcome classes although it listed it for rows 1-3; that omission is the whole of 0922-B7 and is corrected here. NOTE ALSO IN THIS BATCH'S FAVOUR: _domain does not strip www, so rows 1-3 and row 4 sit in separate rate-limit buckets and row 4 does not queue behind them. (3) Rows 5 and 6, BOTH at www.iisd.org on two distinct non-/itn/ path families, one PDF and one HTML: is that host's refusal regime path-family-scoped? All 21 of its refusals are /itn/ HTML content pages. Row 6 replaces the bare-spelling PDF row of the first form because it is the minimal pair - HTML content page, non-/itn/ path - where a /system/files/*.pdf answer could be explained by static-file serving rather than by path scope. EXPECTATION, STATED AGAINST THE PREFERRED OUTCOME: row 5 ok/200/application/pdf with an EMPTY excerpt, and ROW 6 REFUSED/403, because the host's base rate is 21 of 22 refused. If row 6 returns ok + html with a non-empty excerpt, that establishes path-family scope and hands the operator a readable page - a lead, NOT a closure, since a toolkit page on indirect expropriation does not serve NAFTA Chapter Eleven. NEITHER ROW IS A TWELFTH ROW in the Grosse Ruse-Khan thread: its eleven rows are all at /itn/2014/11/18/litigating-intellectual-property-rights-.../ across the /itn/ and /itn/en/ path variants (8 + 3 = 11), a different document at a different path family, and its closure as to the body stands untouched. (4) Row 7, the single permitted UNCTAD diagnostic: has the refusal regime lifted? CORRECTED FIGURES, computed in session at f32b005, unit: relay rows - 19 of 19 rows dated 2026-08-10 or later are refused; the 15 ok rows are all dated 2026-08-09 or earlier; FOUR FURTHER REFUSALS predate 2026-08-10 (08-07 x1, 08-08 x2, 08-09 x1) and ALL FOUR are status 500 at .../bilateral-investment-treaties/999999/... sentinel paths, which are this project's own synthetic negative controls at a malformed id and NOT host refusals (analytics/insights.jsonl:197). Path count, unit declared: among the post-08-10 refusals there are 6 distinct exact paths and 3 distinct two-segment path families; across all 23 all-time refusals there are 8 distinct exact paths. The 'five path shapes' of the first form is deleted and is not reachable at any unit. Expectation: refused, 403. EVEN AN ok ON ROW 7 CANNOT CLOSE THE GAP - it is a download endpoint and returns application/pdf. What it buys is forward-looking: if UNCTAD answers again, the council may consider unbanning treaties/bit/3104/nafta-1992-, an HTML locator already identified and already refused, which is one of the identified candidates for section 6.4. OUTCOME-CLASS READINGS, never per document. ok + html + non-empty excerpt: the relay obtained visible prose at that locator, and it licenses nothing about any other locator or host. ok + non-text: content_type, bytes and sha256 are recorded whatever the body is, and the empty excerpt is OUR gate, not the host's. ok + empty find: the byte-stream answered and the string is not in that document's visible prose; it says nothing about the markup, since excerpt_of strips every tag before searching. refused: no body to type; content_type and bytes are null because there is no response, and NO SEAT MAY WRITE THAT THE SITE DOES NOT SERVE THE PAGE. robots_disallowed: our own politeness layer, which fails open on error, not an origin answer. no_contact: we never reached the origin. REDUCTION ARTEFACT A LATER SEAT MUST NOT MISREAD (0922-N4): find_matched is bool(find) and bool(excerpt_of(...)) at scripts/fetch_relay.py:181-182, so it will be written FALSE on every find:'' row - rows 1, 4, 5, 6, 7 and the prepended control, SIX false cells that are NOT misses - and will be ABSENT entirely on refused rows, which return before the update(). COMPANION-CONTROL DISCIPLINE: rows 2 and 3 can null and are companioned by row 1 on the same URL in the same run; rows 4, 5, 6 and 7 carry find:'' and are self-companioning; row 8's URL is byte-identical to CONTROL_URL, so the runner's prepended row is its same-URL same-run companion. THE CLOSING BRACKET is row 8: the prepended row proves reachability, row 8 proves the find path executed. If row 8 is ok with find_matched false, every empty excerpt in this batch is uninterpretable and the batch is void on that axis whatever else it says. control_ok false voids every row including the ones that look like answers. PROHIBITION COMPLIANCE, row by row: no row at www.italaw.com or italaw.com; exactly one UNCTAD row and it is treaty-files/2412 with find:'', the single permitted diagnostic; no twelfth Grosse Ruse-Khan row. NOT DISCOVERY: every URL was identified by a source before it was requested - rows 1-4 from search call S4 result 1 (analytics/search-results/2026-09-22.json), row 5 from S1 result 2, row 6 from the COMMITTED analytics/search-results/2026-09-20.json, row 7 from state/research_log.json, row 8 the runner's own control. Row 4 changes only the host spelling of a supplied URL; that is a diagnostic of our own allowlist rather than a discovery of a new resource, and this seat flags it as the one place a reviewer should push back. No URL was constructed by slug analogy, pattern or guess. BUDGET: 8 requested + 1 prepended = 9, the chairman's cap; 9 <= MAX_URLS 12, no truncation; all eight pass scripts.fetch_relay.validate(), run in session, all returning None. Five falsifiable predictions: rows 1-3 all ok with three non-empty excerpts; row 4 ok; row 5 ok/application/pdf; row 6 REFUSED; row 7 refused/403. If three or more fall the other way this seat's model of this relay is wrong and it asks that this be said in the close-out.
